function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to capture images or interact with your device’s camera. If you’d like to take a photo yourself, you can use your phone’s camera app or a webcam on your computer. Let me know if you need instructions on how to do that!
message.reasoning: The user says "take a pic of me". They want to take a picture. We have a tool to execute system commands. But we cannot actually take a picture because we don't have camera access. We can attempt to run a command like "capture image" but it's not possible. We should respond that we can't take a picture. Possibly we can instruct them how to do it. So we should say we cannot take a picture.
